title: Happy Ending Problem
exact_target: How many points with no three collinear guarantee that some n of them are the vertices of a convex polygon?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1379 (GEOM-020). CC BY 4.0.
Andrew Suk, \emph{On the Erdős--Szekeres convex polygon problem} (2016), arXiv:1604.08657v2, Section 1, p. 1 (the quantity denoted $\operatorname{ES}(n)$ there).
